# Codebase Map for Issue #802 — Snapshot/Read Surface

Base commit: PR #789 merged as `5856c5bd9`. Current `main` HEAD `7f17bd24c`. Nothing named `SnapshotView`, `OpProgress`, `read_content`, or `download` exists yet — #802 introduces all of them. What exists today is the scaffolding they attach to.

## 1. crates/engine — the Engine facade (from #789)

### Public API — commands in / events out
Everything lives in `crates/engine/src/facade.rs`, re-exported through `crates/engine/src/lib.rs:57-60`.

**Engine handle** (`facade.rs:593-636`): `Engine<T: SeamTypes>`. Constructed via `Engine::new(seams, entropy, profile, api_base_url, gateway) -> (Self, EventStream)` (`facade.rs:641-668`). Key internal state:
- `snapshot: Rc<RefCell<Snapshot>>` (`facade.rs:615`) — the last-known-good gate-passing base snapshot, seeded to `Snapshot::new(NodeId([0u8;16]))`, repainted in place by the resolve-tick loop.
- `held_records`, `alive`, `session: Option<Rc<SessionIdentity>>`, `api`, `gateway: Gateway`, `events: mpsc::UnboundedSender<Event>`.

**Public methods:**
- `async start(&mut self, secret: LoginSecret) -> Result<(), EngineError>` (`facade.rs:684`) — cold-start pipeline: derives session, logs in, runs `cold_start_data_path`, sets base snapshot, spawns liveness + resolve-tick loops.
- `async command(&mut self, command: Command) -> Result<(), EngineError>` (`facade.rs:1030`) — the single write entry point. Only `Create` (metadata-only), `Delete`, `Rename`, `Relink`, `SiweLogin` are implemented; all others return `EngineError::Unimplemented`. Content-bearing creates and `UpdateContent` are explicitly `Unimplemented` (`facade.rs:1045-1049`).
- `async view(&self) -> Result<EngineView, EngineError>` (`facade.rs:1092`) — **the existing read surface**. Returns `EngineView` (`facade.rs:482-524`) wrapping the rendered `Snapshot`; offers FUSE-shaped `root()`, `children(parent) -> Vec<NodeAttrs>`, `lookup(parent, name)`, `attrs(node)`, `statfs()`. This is the key-bearing internal projection that #802's key-free `SnapshotView` will parallel/replace at the WASM boundary.
- `fn root(&self) -> NodeId` (`facade.rs:1103`), `fn profile(&self)` (`facade.rs:1170`).

**Command enum** (`facade.rs:178-293`): `Create{parent,name,kind,content:Option<PlaintextContent>}`, `Delete`, `Rename`, `Relink`, `UpdateContent`, `SetFocus{node:Option<NodeId>}`, `ManualRefresh`, `ImportContact`, `Grant`, `Revoke`, `Downgrade`, `CreateInviteLink`, `AcceptShare`, `RotateNow`, `SiweLogin`, `Logout`. Hand-written `Debug` prints variant name only (`facade.rs:319-323`).

**Event enum** (`facade.rs:328-364`): `SnapshotUpdated` (payload-free), `StalenessChanged{level:Staleness}`, `WithheldUpdateEscalation{ipns_name:Vec<u8>}`, `DeadLetter{op_id:OpId}`, `AttributableAbuse{description:String}`, `RenewalFailed{routing_key,detail}`. **These are all payload-minimal today** — `SnapshotUpdated` carries no data; the host must call `view()` to read state. #802's per-node pending/deadLetter overlay and `OpProgress` channel are not represented in this enum yet.

`EventStream` (`facade.rs:466-475`): `async next() -> Option<Event>` over an unbounded mpsc receiver.

`NodeAttrs` (`facade.rs:90-100`): `{id, name, kind, content_version:u64}` — note it has **no size/mtime** ("content size and timestamps land with the content-plane slice", `facade.rs:88-89`). #802's `{id,name,kind,size?,mtime?,pending,deadLetter,contentVersion}` extends this.

### How SnapshotUpdated is emitted today
Four sites, all fire-and-forget over the events channel:
1. Cold-start boot, after first projection — `crates/engine/src/sync/boot.rs:164,216`.
2. Resolve-tick loop, when a gate-passing `Adopted` repaints the base cell — `facade.rs:1011-1012` (guarded by `refresh_base_from_outcome`).
3. Metadata op staged — `stage_and_notify` at `facade.rs:1160`.
4. It is a bare push-invalidation trigger: hosts re-`view()` on receipt. There is no per-node pending/deadLetter flag on the wire.

### sync/model::Snapshot — exact structure
`crates/engine/src/sync/model.rs`:
- `Snapshot` (`model.rs:65-71`): `{ root: NodeId, nodes: BTreeMap<NodeId,NodeMeta> (private), links: Vec<Link> (private) }`.
- `NodeMeta` (`model.rs:21-36`): `{ id: NodeId, name: String (as-entered), kind: NodeKind, record_sequence: u64, content_version: u64 }`. **No size, no mtime fields exist.** `content_version` is here.
- `Link` (`model.rs:52-61`): `{ parent, child, link_counter: u64 }` (dual-link tiebreak).
- Accessor methods #802 will lean on: `node(id)`, `children(parent) -> Vec<&NodeMeta>` (sorted by id, `model.rs:201-213`), `ancestors(node) -> Vec<NodeId>` (nearest-first to root, cycle-guarded, `model.rs:218-231`), `parent_of`, `record_sequence`, `contains`.
- `collation_key(name)` (`model.rs:268`) — the strict name comparator.

**Projection into Snapshot**: `crates/engine/src/sync/project.rs` — `project_root(root, adopted) -> Snapshot` (`project.rs:20-35`) lifts direct children only from `ReadBody::Folder{children,...}`, carrying `child.name`, `map_kind(child.kind)`, `child.link_counter`. Root sequence set from `adopted.sequence`. Size/mtime not projected (the `ReadBody::Folder` also carries `created_at`/`modified_at` but they are discarded — see `project.rs:66-76` test).

**Rendering (base ⊕ overlay)**: `Engine::render()` (`facade.rs:1108-1114`) = `apply_overlay(&base, &pending_ops)`. `pending_ops()` (`facade.rs:1119-1128`) reads the durable staging store, `decode_queue`s it FIFO, drops undecodables.

### Pending ops / dead-letter tracking (offline op queue)
- The durable op queue is the **StagingStore seam** (`crates/engine/src/seams/staging_store.rs`); `OpId(pub u64)` defined at `staging_store.rs:8`.
- Ops staged via `stage_op` (`crates/engine/src/sync/staging.rs`), returning `StageOutcome::Queued{..}` / `RejectedOverBudget{..}` (`facade.rs:1153-1166`).
- Pending state is **not** tracked per-node today — it is a flat FIFO queue read on every render. There is no per-node "pending" or "deadLetter" boolean anywhere; #802 must derive these by diffing the overlay ops against the base per node.
- **Dead-letter** is surfaced only at cold-start: undecodable queue entries emit `Event::DeadLetter{op_id}` and are removed from the durable queue (gated on successful send) — `facade.rs:840-864`. Ops that terminally fail rebase are documented to dead-letter (`facade.rs:344-348`) but the rebase-failure emission path is a later slice. `Op`/`OpKind` live in `crates/engine/src/sync/op.rs` (`OpKind` enum at `op.rs:35`).

### Content download/read path (existing fetch/decrypt)
The whole verified-fetch machinery `read_content` will compose already exists in `crates/engine/src/content/`:
- **`read_block(gateway, http, cid_str, expected_cid, plane) -> Result<Vec<u8>, ReadError>`** — `crates/engine/src/content/read.rs:175-231`. Fetches one block over the ordered `Gateway` source set (token-authed accelerator first, then public fallbacks), CID-verifies via `cipherbox_core::content::verify_cid`, fail-closed `ReadError::TrustViolation` on mismatch, rotates on availability failure/over-cap, caps body size. `ReadError` = `TrustViolation | TooLarge | Unavailable` (`read.rs:128-150`).
- `Gateway`/`GatewaySource`/`GatewayConfig` (`read.rs:55-125`) — the engine holds a resolved `gateway: Gateway` field.
- `ContentPlane::{Leaf,Root}` (`read.rs:37-53`) pins the codec.
- `leaf_range_for_byte_range(offset,length,chunk_size,leaf_count)` (`read.rs:282-305`) — chunk-aligned range mapping.
- **DAG/manifest**: `RootManifest{chunk_size:u64, size:u64, leaf_cids:Vec<Vec<u8>>}` (`crates/engine/src/content/dag.rs:143-150`), `decode_root(root_block)` (`dag.rs:159`), `assemble` (`dag.rs:106`). `SealedContent{content_cid, root_block, leaves}` (`content/mod.rs:44-55`).

I've verified the scout report against the code and traced every path the issue touches. Here is the implementation plan.

# Scout-report verification

Confirmed accurate (with evidence):
- `Engine<T: SeamTypes>` facade shape, `snapshot: Rc<RefCell<Snapshot>>`, unbounded events, metadata-only commands, `view()` FUSE-shaped — `crates/engine/src/facade.rs:593-1173`. Content-bearing create rejects Unimplemented at facade.rs:1046.
- `NodeMeta` has no size/mtime/content-CID — `crates/engine/src/sync/model.rs:22-36`. `project_root` discards `created_at`/`modified_at` — `crates/engine/src/sync/project.rs:26` — **and also discards `ChildRef.ipns_name`**, which matters more than the scout noted (it is the only way to locate a child's own record).
- Dead-letter: only cold-start decode failures, emitted then removed from the queue — facade.rs:852-864. No retained set, no node attribution.
- `read_block` fail-closed CID verify + plane pinning — `crates/engine/src/content/read.rs:175-220`; `RootManifest{chunk_size,size,leaf_cids}` — `content/dag.rs`; `ContentKey` — `content/chunk.rs:24`.
- wasm `host.rs` exposes only `start`/`command`/`nextEvent` (host.rs:180-221); boundary pattern is opaque wasm-bindgen objects with `kind()` + per-variant getters (lib.rs:330-408). No serde-wasm-bindgen anywhere.
- `protocol.ts` `WorkerRequest` = start|command only; `CorrelatedTransport.Pending.resolve: () => void` (void-only responses, correlatedTransport.ts:17); broadcast wire has no read path.
- **`renewalFailed` missing from `EventDescriptor` is confirmed and is a live bug**: `crates/wasm/src/lib.rs:346` emits kind `"renewalFailed"`, `commandCodec.ts:110-129` throws on unknown kinds, and `serve.ts:54-56` converts the event-pump throw into `fatal`, terminally killing the transport. The first real `Event::RenewalFailed` bricks every tab. Must fix in this slice.

Inaccuracies / corrections:
1. **`open_chunk` is not in `content/chunk.rs`** — it lives in core: `crates/core/src/content/seal.rs:45`. The engine's chunk.rs only calls it in tests.
2. Understated: **`Staleness` is entirely dormant** — `sync/staleness.rs::classify` is a pure function with zero production callers; `Event::StalenessChanged` is never emitted anywhere; the engine tracks no `last_success`/`reconcile_in_flight`/connectivity state. `snapshot()`'s Staleness field needs new tracking state, not just a call into the classifier.
3. Scout said "No node→contentCid map exists" — true, but the deeper fact: **it structurally cannot exist from the root projection**. `ChildRef` is `{id, name, ipnsName, kind, linkCounter}` with explicitly "No key wraps, no size/mtime mirrors" (`crates/core/src/seal/body.rs:10-14`). Content refs live only in the file's **own** record (`ReadBody::File.versions[].{content_cid, content_key, size, modified_at}`, body.rs:140-150, 246-251).

# Decided answers to the 7 design questions

**Q1 — where `read_content` gets CID + key: resolve the file's own record on demand.** Evidence: `Version` (body.rs:140-150) carries `content_cid`, secret `content_key` (zeroizing, read via `Version::content_key()`, body.rs:172), `size`, `modified_at`; head of newest-first `versions` is current. Child records are *not* resolved anywhere today — only the root, via `RootAdopter` (net/adopter.rs:144) and the resolve tick (facade.rs:945-1019). Extending the Snapshot with content refs is impossible without resolving children anyway, so `read_content` resolves the child record on demand through a new reduced **`ChildAdopter`** (a non-scope-root record has no grant section — `Envelope` is `{v, id, epochTag, readSealed, writeSealed?, grantSection?}`, `crates/core/src/seal/envelope.rs:5` — so the full six-stage `gate::adopt` cannot apply; the child pipeline is: record verify → head-block fetch fail-closed on CID → envelope decode → `env.id == node` and `env.scope == scope` transplant checks → per-name sequence floor + scope read-epoch floor (`gate/floor.rs`) → AAD-bound `open_read_body` under `kdf::read_key(kdf::node_seed(scope_seed, node_id))`, mirroring RootAdopter's derivation at adopter.rs:171-172). The scope read seed is recovered by the owner arm at every root adopt (owner blob, adopter.rs:161-167) but currently dropped; retain it in a new engine-held `scope_read_seeds` map (in-engine key material only — nothing crosses the boundary; `read_content` returns plaintext `Vec<u8>`, key stays inside). Reuse `resolve()`/`resolve_gated` (net/resolve.rs:119) by implementing `Adopter` for `ChildAdopter`, which gives cache-first reads and snapshot-cache write-back for free. Two smaller decisions inside this: (a) `ChildRef.ipns_name` bytes are treated as the UTF-8 bytes of the canonical base36 name string, parsed fail-closed via `IpnsName::parse` — consistent with the existing convention that the snapshot cache keys on `name.as_str().as_bytes()` (resolve.rs:155) and `HeldRecord.routing_key: String`; (b) a child envelope that *does* carry a grant section (a nested scope root) fails closed in v1 — granted-subscope reads land with the grants slice.

**Q2 — size/mtime: project what exists, leave children `None`.** `ChildRef` carries neither (body.rs:14), so focused-folder children project `size: None, mtime: None` — matching blueprint/web-client.md:145-147 progressive hydration ("name and kind render instantly from the parent's child refs; size/mtime arrive as child resolves land"). Two things hydrate now: the folder's own `modified_at` (currently discarded at project.rs:26) is projected onto the folder node; and after a successful `read_content` adopt, the file's head-version `size`/`modified_at` are folded into the base snapshot (a gate-passing adopt, so it may legally touch the snapshot) with a `SnapshotUpdated` emit. Bulk child-resolve hydration (focus-window tick over children) is a follow-up.

**Q3 — per-node pending/deadLetter: pending from the queue, dead-letter from a new retained set, honestly limited.** `pending` = node ids appearing as `Op.target` in the decoded durable queue (`Op.target: NodeId`, sync/op.rs:25) — computed at `snapshot()` time from the same `pending_ops()` read that feeds the overlay, so flag and overlay are consistent. Dead letters: the engine currently deletes the queue row and forgets (facade.rs:852-864); add `dead_letters: Rc<RefCell<BTreeMap<OpId, Option<NodeId>>>>` retained for the session, populated at the cold-start dead-letter site (node = `None` — an undecodable op cannot name its target) and by future rebase dead-letters (which will know the node). `SnapshotView` gets per-child `dead_letter: bool` (true iff some retained entry maps `Some(node)`) plus a top-level `dead_letters: Vec<OpId>` list so hosts can render the persistent notice today. The per-node flag is structurally wired but stays false until the rebase slice attributes nodes — stated in docs, not papered over.

**Q4 — OpProgress: a new `Event` variant on the existing stream, download phases live, upload phases dormant.** blueprint/web-client.md:193 ("per-file progress/error is event-stream state on the upload's op id") pins it to the one event stream — no second channel, no new worker pump. Shape: `Event::OpProgress { op_id: Option<OpId>, node: NodeId, phase: OpPhase, error: Option<String> }` with `OpPhase { DownloadStarted, DownloadCompleted, DownloadFailed }` now (`op_id` is `Option` because downloads don't ride the op queue; upload phases — Staged/Sealing/Uploading/Published, with a real `op_id` — are added by the content-plane slice). Emission points: entry/exit/error of `read_content`.

**Q5 — `snapshot(folder)` is a parameterized pure read, independent of SetFocus.** Signature `Engine::snapshot(&self, folder: NodeId) -> Result<SnapshotView, EngineError>` over the rendered view (base ⊕ overlay, same `render()` as `view()`, facade.rs:1108). `SetFocus` remains a separate (still-Unimplemented) command; the issue's "key-free projection from sync/model::Snapshot" confirms no network, no focus coupling. Fail-closed: folder absent from the rendered view → new `EngineError::UnknownNode`; present but `kind == File` → new `EngineError::NotAFolder`. Note honestly: for a non-root folder, base children aren't resolved yet (only the root's direct children project today), so a subfolder shows overlay-created children only until the child-resolve/focus-window slice — correct behavior, documented.

**Q6 — broadcast read path: `cb:read` request / `cb:response` with payload; download bytes as `Blob`.** Followers round-trip reads through the leader: new `FollowerMessage` `{ type: 'cb:read'; clientId; requestId; read: {kind:'snapshot'; folder: Uint8Array} | {kind:'download'; node: Uint8Array} }`; the ok-`cb:response` gains `result?: SnapshotDescriptor` and `content?: Blob`. Snapshot views are small plain data (structured clone fine). Download bytes ride a `Blob`, not a raw `ArrayBuffer`/`Uint8Array`: BroadcastChannel structured-clones per receiving context, and `Blob`'s immutable backing store is shared — exactly the rationale already used for uploads in `hoistContent` (broadcast.ts:90-101, "no byte copies"). The follower converts via `blob.arrayBuffer()`. # Scout-report verification

Confirmed accurate (with evidence):
- `Engine<T: SeamTypes>` facade shape, `snapshot: Rc<RefCell<Snapshot>>`, unbounded events, metadata-only commands, `view()` FUSE-shaped — `crates/engine/src/facade.rs:593-1173`. Content-bearing create rejects Unimplemented at facade.rs:1046.

- Dead-letter: only cold-start decode failures, emitted then removed from the queue — facade.rs:852-864. No retained set, no node attribution.
- `read_block` fail-closed CID verify + plane pinning — `crates/engine/src/content/read.rs:175-220`; `RootManifest{chunk_size,size,leaf_cids}` — `content/dag.rs`; `ContentKey` — `content/chunk.rs:24`.

- `protocol.ts` `WorkerRequest` = start|command only; `CorrelatedTransport.Pending.resolve: () => void` (void-only responses, correlatedTransport.ts:17); broadcast wire has no read path.
- **`renewalFailed` missing from `EventDescriptor` is confirmed and is a live bug**: `crates/wasm/src/lib.rs:346` emits kind `"renewalFailed"`, `commandCodec.ts:110-129` throws on unknown kinds, and `serve.ts:54-56` converts the event-pump throw into `fatal`, terminally killing the transport. The first real `Event::RenewalFailed` bricks every tab. Must fix in this slice.

Inaccuracies / corrections:
1. **`open_chunk` is not in `content/chunk.rs`** — it lives in core: `crates/core/src/content/seal.rs:45`. The engine's chunk.rs only calls it in tests.
2. Understated: **`Staleness` is entirely dormant** — `sync/staleness.rs::classify` is a pure function with zero production callers; `Event::StalenessChanged` is never emitted anywhere; the engine tracks no `last_success`/`reconcile_in_flight`/connectivity state. `snapshot()`'s Staleness field needs new tracking state, not just a call into the classifier.
3. Scout said "No node→contentCid map exists" — true, but the deeper fact: **it structurally cannot exist from the root projection**. `ChildRef` is `{id, name, ipnsName, kind, linkCounter}` with explicitly "No key wraps, no size/mtime mirrors" (`crates/core/src/seal/body.rs:10-14`). Content refs live only in the file's **own** record (`ReadBody::File.versions[].{content_cid, content_key, size, modified_at}`, body.rs:140-150, 246-251).

# Decided answers to the 7 design questions

**Q1 — where `read_content` gets CID + key: resolve the file's own record on demand.** Evidence: `Version` (body.rs:140-150) carries `content_cid`, secret `content_key` (zeroizing, read via `Version::content_key()`, body.rs:172), `size`, `modified_at`; head of newest-first `versions` is current. Child records are *not* resolved anywhere today — only the root, via `RootAdopter` (net/adopter.rs:144) and the resolve tick (facade.rs:945-1019). Extending the Snapshot with content refs is impossible without resolving children anyway, so `read_content` resolves the child record on demand through a new reduced **`ChildAdopter`** (a non-scope-root record has no grant section — `Envelope` is `{v, id, epochTag, readSealed, writeSealed?, grantSection?}`, `crates/core/src/seal/envelope.rs:5` — so the full six-stage `gate::adopt` cannot apply; the child pipeline is: record verify → head-block fetch fail-closed on CID → envelope decode → `env.id == node` and `env.scope == scope` transplant checks → per-name sequence floor + scope read-epoch floor (`gate/floor.rs`) → AAD-bound `open_read_body` under `kdf::read_key(kdf::node_seed(scope_seed, node_id))`, mirroring RootAdopter's derivation at adopter.rs:171-172). The scope read seed is recovered by the owner arm at every root adopt (owner blob, adopter.rs:161-167) but currently dropped; retain it in a new engine-held `scope_read_seeds` map (in-engine key material only — nothing crosses the boundary; `read_content` returns plaintext `Vec<u8>`, key stays inside). Reuse `resolve()`/`resolve_gated` (net/resolve.rs:119) by implementing `Adopter` for `ChildAdopter`, which gives cache-first reads and snapshot-cache write-back for free. **Q2 — size/mtime: project what exists, leave children `None`.** `ChildRef` carries neither (body.rs:14), so focused-folder children project `size: None, mtime: None` — matching blueprint/web-client.md:145-147 progressive hydration ("name and kind render instantly from the parent's child refs; size/mtime arrive as child resolves land"). Two things hydrate now: the folder's own `modified_at` (currently discarded at project.rs:26) is projected onto the folder node; and after a successful `read_content` adopt, the file's head-version `size`/`modified_at` are folded into the base snapshot (a gate-passing adopt, so it may legally touch the snapshot) with a `SnapshotUpdated` emit.
